name: fixup_zero_kv
description: fixup_zero_kv(out, lse, kv_lens, cum_seq_lens, max_seq_len) -> (out, lse). out has shape [total_tokens, num_heads, v_head_dim] and lse has shape [total_tokens, num_heads]; kv_lens has shape [batch] and cum_seq_lens has shape [batch+1]. For each batch index i with kv_lens[i] == 0, set out[cum_seq_lens[i]:cum_seq_lens[i+1]] to zero and lse[same rows, :] to -inf. All other entries retain their input values. The native function mutates and returns the same out and lse tensors, with no new output. It supports contiguous flat/2D layouts and a strided 3D/2D fallback. max_seq_len is a sizing/tuning argument; exercised shapes use 1 to 257 requests and 16 heads by 128 value dimensions.
